description: Exchange hack and drain alerts from Muhabbit's incident engine (large outflows to unlabelled wallets, withdrawal halts, security-researcher posts, exchange statements). One item per incident: tier (suspected = unconfirmed, confirmed), exchange, headline, USD at risk, assets, evidence signals and sources, a timeline with named clocks, and links to its hash-chained public record entries. Newest update first. Use for 'is an exchange being hacked right now?' or 'any exchange incidents since T?'. Informational, not advice. (Free when tier is confirmed, the default; that feed needs no credentials and returns at most 20. Otherwise paid: x402 payment, or an API key or wallet token on a paid plan.)

exchange.description: Exchange key, lowercase, e.g. binance, okx, bybit, bitget, coinbase

limit.description: Max alerts, 1-100 (default 20). The free confirmed feed returns at most 20.

since.description: ISO 8601 instant, e.g. 2026-10-29T00:00:00Z. Only alerts updated (new evidence or a tier change) at or after it, on the engine's detection clock. An update can become visible a few seconds after its updated_at, so when polling pass your previous poll time minus 60s and dedupe on (id, tier, updated_at).

tier.description: confirmed (free): confirmed incidents only. suspected (paid): unconfirmed incidents, published before confirmation. all (paid): both.

name: muhabbit_alerts
